incidents.name: DBW LP dividend double counting
incidents.notes: DBW pays LP dividends from the caller's current LP balance without recording that the position had already been paid, so moving the same LP between addresses collected the dividend repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: DBW 0xBF5BAea5113e9EB7009a6680747F2c7569dfC2D6 created 2022-09-30T13:59:48Z by 0xe130447082cc26dec1ff3d3e0ee2e8b19c143b5e, unrelated to attack sender 0xe828d2cd28def4eb0d1b398a1972f64ceabdb99b; it is an EIP-1967 proxy with 18 Upgraded events, the last at 1678202440 (2023-03-07T15:20:40Z), which is the basis for the age. Loss verified onchain: 20,190.65 USDT left the DBW pair and 19,856.55 USDT reached the attacker.
